name: Fermentation Gozen Set Meal
description: Customize your set in 4 steps: 1. Choose a Fermented Main Dish — Meat, Fish, or Fermented Karaage (fried chicken) 2. Pick Your Fermented Vegetable Side Dishes — 5 kinds or 3 kinds of small seasonal veggie plates 3. Select Your Miso Ball — Choose your flavor of handmade miso soup base 4. Choose Your Drink — House-roasted Coffee, Oolong Tea, or Syrup Soda (Upgrade to an alcoholic drink for an additional charge: Minoh Beer, Akishika Sake, or Wine)

name: Kids Lunch Set
description: A specially sized set for children (elementary school age and under). Choose from a balanced kids' plate, a gentle white miso ramen for small appetites, or a simple rice side.

name: Karaage Set Meal
description: A hearty lunch set featuring our signature Shin fermented fried chicken, served with rice and seasonal accompaniments. A satisfying, well-rounded meal.

name: Lunch Set
description: A flexible daytime set built around your choice of ramen. Pick the combination that suits your appetite and mood — keep it simple with just ramen (Set A), add our signature fermented fried chicken (Set C), or treat yourself to a glass of Minoh Beer or Akishika Sake alongside your bowl (Sets D & E). Each set is designed for a complete, satisfying lunch experience at Mitsukabōzu.
